subject.title: fix: keep usage day buckets correct across DST

question: Should OpenClaw accept `timeZone` as the additive public usage RPC field for DST-aware day bucketing while retaining `utcOffset` as the compatibility fallback?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes a public Gateway/UI request contract and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label, so maintainer intent should accept or revise the contract before landing.

options.title: Accept the additive contract
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers accept `timeZone` as the public field and `utcOffset` as the fallback for older or ICU-limited clients.

options.title: Revise the protocol shape first
options.body: Ask for a different field name, fallback rule, or generated-client shape before merge if this contract is not the intended public API.

options.title: Defer the bug fix
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open only if maintainers want to defer DST-correct local usage history despite the source-backed bug.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive contract
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers accept `timeZone` as the public field and `utcOffset` as the fallback for older or ICU-limited clients.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and his prior profile usage work is central to the affected surface.
